mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals anticipated higher discount rates, reducing the present value of future equity cash flows and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal (FEDFUNDS rising), or Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in monthly unemployment (UNRATE below 5.0%) signals improved labor market conditions, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not positive when UNRATE falls below 5.0% in 1 month, or t-test p>0.05 showing no significant link between UNRATE and returns.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS >2.5%) and falling unemployment (UNRATE <5.0%) create conflicting signals; their interaction amplifies market uncertainty, yet historically this combination has driven positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS >2.5% AND UNRATE <5.0% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX returns not positive when both FEDFUNDS >2.5% and UNRATE <5.0% in the same month, or interaction effect rank IC <0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, rising supply (INDPRO) alongside low inflation (CPIAUCSL <2%) indicates sustainable growth, boosting market optimism and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases AND CPIAUCSL <2% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX returns not positive during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO rises and CPIAUCSL <2%, or t-test p>0.05 showing no significant link.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals robust demand, elevating corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not positive when GDPC1 increases, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in monthly demand (HOUST above 2000 units) triggers optimism about economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not positive when HOUST crosses above 2000, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDP growth (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signal robust demand and production capacity, amplifying market confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the same month
failure_condition: SPX returns not positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase, or interaction effect rank IC <0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS >3%), rising CPIAUCSL indexes signal inflationary pressures, dampening equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS >3% for 2 months AND CPIAUCSL increasing
failure_condition: SPX returns not negative during monetary tightening cycle when FEDFUNDS>3% and CPIAUCSL rising, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 1-year window.
